messages.text: Seeing a spike of checkout errors in Sentry. Anyone else? Opening this thread as the incident.
Yes, support has 6 tickets: checkout page goes blank after adding to cart. Mostly guest users.
Error is `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'amount')` in formatPrice. Started ~09:12.
That's my PR #482, it went out at 09:08. Guest carts don't have `total` until shipping is picked. I removed the guard.
Let's revert instead of hotfix. Arjun can you open the revert PR? Token for the status page bot is xoxb-1234-abcd-not-real, don't paste it again.
Deploy is live. Error rate back to zero in the last 2 min. Watching for 15 more.
Resolved. No new errors since 09:43. I'll write the postmortem. Action items: add guest-cart test, add Sentry alert to #incidents.
